scope: Three US DOE 2023 Critical Materials engineered commodities (electrical steel, silicon carbide, synthetic graphite) and eleven IMA September 2026 critical-element mineral species (bainbridgeite-(NdCe), piilonenite-(Nd), mckelveyite-(Y), adamsite-(Y), thomasclarkite-(Y), petrukite, ferrokesterite, sakuraiite, ammonioborite, weeksite, richetite) with complete primary-source visual inspection and bounded abiotic or structural claims. No microbial activity, industrial deployment or unmeasured elemental recovery inferred.

selection.reason: Missing US DOE 2023 Critical Material for Energy (88 FR 51792, 51797); distinct grain-oriented and non-grain-oriented Fe-Si alloy commodity separate from elemental silicon and bulk steel.

Missing US DOE 2023 Critical Material for Energy (88 FR 51792, 51797); distinct wide-bandgap semiconductor and Acheson-process abrasive commodity supported by USGS MCS 2026 Manufactured Abrasives and Silicon chapters.

Missing US DOE 2023 Critical Material for Energy (88 FR 51792, 51797); distinct graphitized petroleum-coke/coal-tar-pitch commodity separate from natural graphite, supported by USGS 2021 Minerals Yearbook Graphite and USGS MCS 2026 Graphite.
Missing IMA 2023-018 Nd-Ce-ordered mckelveyite-group carbonate from Mont Saint-Hilaire (holotype CMNMC 90534, hornfels CMNMC 52468); complete EJM 38 (2026) 419-429 primary PDF inspected.
Missing IMA 2025-031 (master list 2025-031b) Nd-dominant layered NaNd(CO3)2(H2O)3 carbonate from Poudrette quarry (holotype CMNMC 93393); complete EJM 38 (2026) 337-345 primary PDF inspected.

Missing IMA 1964-025 (1965 description and 2008 Mont Saint-Hilaire 1M/2M polytype crystal-structure refinement) Y-dominant carbonate; complete AM 50 (1965) 593-612 and CM 46 (2008) 195-204 primary PDFs inspected.
Missing IMA 1999-020 Y-dominant sodium-yttrium carbonate hexahydrate from Poudrette quarry (cotypes CMNMC 82939 and 82940); complete CM 38 (2000) 1457-1466 primary PDF inspected.
Missing IMA 1997-047 Y-dominant sodium-rare-earth bicarbonate hydrate from Poudrette quarry (cotypes CMNMI 81553-81555); complete CM 36 (1998) 1293-1300 primary PDF inspected.

Missing IMA 1985-052 indium-bearing orthorhombic Pmn21 stannite-group sulfide from Herb claim, Mount Pleasant, and Ikuno mine (cotypes GSC 65049-65052); complete CM 27 (1989) 673-688 primary PDF inspected.
Missing IMA 1985-012 (Rn) tetragonal I-4 stannite-group Cu2FeSnS4 sulfide from Cligga mine (cotypes GSC 65048 and BM 1984, 844); complete CM 27 (1989) 673-688 primary PDF inspected.
Missing IMA 1965-017 indium-dominant (Cu,Zn,Fe)3(In,Sn)S4 sulfide from Ikuno mine; complete CM 24 (1986) 405-409 and CM 27 (1989) 673-688 primary PDFs inspected.

Missing grandfathered (1933) / Rn (1999) ammonium borate hydrate from Larderello; complete AM 18 (1933) 480-492 primary PDF inspected, including water-loss holds and Larderello crystallizer conversion.
Missing IMA 1960 s.p. potassium uranyl silicate hydrate from Thomas Range; complete AM 45 (1960) 39-52 primary PDF inspected, including reversible dehydration holds.
Missing grandfathered (1947) lead uranyl oxide hydrate from Shinkolobwe; complete CM 36 (1998) 187-199 primary triclinic P1 crystal-structure PDF inspected.

deduplication.note: No pre-existing owner record in data/records/ matched any of the 14 selected commodities or mineral species prior to Round 117 creation.
